reads_as: a hooded shadowy figure confesses 'I am a FRAUD' in screaming red — the imposter-syndrome gut-punch
layout_map: Hooded illustrated figure (sketch/cutout style, eyes closed, head bowed) fills the left third, occupying cells 1-2-5-6-9-10-13-14, face center ~x180,y330, bleeding off the bottom edge against a near-black grid-textured background. Two-row headline sits right of the figure across the top and middle: row 1 'I am a' in white Inter-bold, baseline ~y90, spanning cells 6-7-8 (x420-1180); row 2 'FRAUD...' in giant bold RED caps, baseline ~y190, spanning cells 6-7-8, the accent payoff word. Bottom-right has two small app/logo icons on the baseline ~y560: a Stack Overflow icon in cell 15 (~x355) and a green OpenAI/ChatGPT rounded-square icon in cell 16 (~x490). why_it_works: the shadowed faceless figure plus a one-word red confession ('FRAUD') turns a private fear into a public scroll-stopping admission
